tests.title: accepts only the bare token and refuses every option, timeline enable and empty argument with exact messages
declares a stream step that allocates frames, keeps counts and packets, and refuses rate conversion and FLAC input
reserves one output frame plus the per-channel previous sample at the working width on both planners
negotiates native picks: u8 and s16 to s16p, s32 to s32p, flt to fltp and dbl to dblp, with a single rounding only from float input
matches a C transcription with two's-complement wrap and float32 rounding, independent of frame splits
converts packed and u8 input to the negotiated planar format before differencing
refuses non-finite floating input, enforces the frame allocation limit and observes cancellation
matches native framecrc across source formats, channel counts, frame splits and padding in the native format and s16
writes native-identical WAV and raw PCM from WAV and raw inputs
filters the whole input before output -ss, -t, -to and -frames:a, as native does
matches native where neighbouring format lists merge with its own, across source formats
fails explicitly before output for options, timeline enable and neighbour merges native would run in another format

compares: 108 framecrc: u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 x 1-3 channels x native codec and s16 x aderivative, asetnsamples=7,aderivative, aderivative,apad=pad_len=5, aderivative,aderivative (20000 samples at 8000 Hz, full-scale extremes)
72 WAV/raw file bytes from WAV and raw stereo input, native codec and s16
192 framecrc with output -ss/-t/-ss -t/-ss -to/-frames:a/sub-sample -t over three chains
162 framecrc for neighbour merges (aformat=s16p/s16/fltp/dbl/s32 and volume float/fixed before and after)
8 native exit statuses: 2 shared refusals, 6 native-accepted runs refused before output

unsupported: any option, including the empty argument 'aderivative='
neighbour merges the negotiation model cannot reproduce (fixed volume before it on float/u8/dbl input)

notes: Setup durations: submodule 45 s, npm ci 9 s, reference:build 171 s, baseline unit run 81 s.
No additional shared edit was needed.
Native accepts 'aderivative=' and enable; both are refused explicitly per scope.
Float-to-integer and float-source neighbour cases are gated to linux x64; on other platforms those comparisons are skipped.
FLAC tests that need edge-flac.wasm and resample-checkpoint golden digests (macOS arm64) fail in the baseline and after the change, identically.
